save_active_memory.description: Allows JIN to save active memory conditions.
rules: Use when a clear, concrete unresolved intention, promise, condition, reminder, live rule, or future condition appears and keeping it pending would help the current or near-future conversation.
conditions is the required default field; fill it with the concrete pending item to preserve.
Emit one plain JSON object inside the tag body. Put each optional custom field beside conditions at the JSON root; do not nest custom fields under fields or any other wrapper.
Do not save trivial exchanges, unstable ideas, identity anchors, broad user preferences, etc.
